name: Dumbbell Upright Row
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs using an overhand grip.
Brace your core and pull both dumbbells straight up close to your torso by leading with your elbows.
Raise your elbows out and up until your upper arms reach roughly shoulder height with your hands remaining below your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells smoothly back down to the front of your thighs under control.
tips: Keep your wrists neutral and avoid shrugging your shoulders up toward your ears.
Stop at shoulder height or slightly below if lifting higher causes discomfort in the front of your shoulders.
